craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of fitted joinery — utsāha as qualifier meets qualified without loss. Nominal mirror kept (verbless SA); non-difference-shine end-weight — the reflection-object defined by shining-form. Rejected: (a) verbs for nominals → killed by SA mirror. (b) pith→core → killed: pith keeps organic density. Read aloud: THERE-too, WHAT the WORLD-ly re-FLECT up-ON — … KNOW-er WHOSE-pith IS-diff-er-ence OF-non-DIFF-er-ence-SHINE.

lines: There too, what the worldly reflect upon —
that same: the knower whose pith is difference of non-difference-shine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi yaḥ parāmarśaviṣayo laukikasya saḥ cidabhedaprathārūpabhedasārasya vedituḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is reflection's object for the worldly? → The worldly one's reflection-object is the knower whose pith is difference in non-difference-shining form.
c1_essence: Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11).
Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).
